queue.name: Window Blind Slats
queue.prompt: Relight this image. Change nothing else except the lighting. Keep the existing background and setting exactly as they are and add nothing to the scene. A single hard source at camera-left passes through horizontal slats out of frame, laying a series of parallel bright bands and dark shadows diagonally across the subject and the background behind them. The bands bend as they cross the body and stay sharp-edged. Everything outside the bands sits in low fill. Hard-edged parallel shadows, physically plausible bend over form, realistic skin texture, subtle grain.
